subject: Candidate relay, debrief cadence, and AV checklist for remote full-loop
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Alex Tran <alex.tran@gmail.com>
Cc: TalentFlow Recruiting <recruit@talentflow.io>
Date: 2025-08-18T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Candidate relay, debrief cadence, and AV checklist for remote full-loop

Thanks team — quick consolidated plan for Alex's remote full-loop next week. I know we typically do the usual panel shuffle, but I want to tighten handoffs and ensure we have a clean debrief cadence so feedback is captured immediately. High-level:

- Candidate: Alex Tran (attached resume).
- Date: Wed, Aug 27 — 4 interview slots, all remote (Zoom).
- Goal: keep each technical slot to 45 min with a 10-min buffer and a 10-min synchronous debrief immediately after the last technical slot.

Action items (please confirm below):
1) Panel sequencing: who takes slot 2 and slot 3 (we want depth diversity across frontend/backend/infra).
2) Debrief flow: do we join a short break-out room (recommended) and run the scorecard live? Link below.
3) AV checks: candidate + interviewers to run a 5-min AV check 20 min before first slot — see attached AV checklist for fallback options.

Attachments: resume_alex_tran.pdf, calendar-invite.ics, av-checklist.pdf

If there are any conflicts, flag them here and we can swap slots. 

— Mateo
Sr. Eng Manager, Hiring Coordinator
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Alex Tran <alex.tran@gmail.com>
Date: 2025-08-18T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate relay, debrief cadence, and AV checklist for remote full-loop

On Mon, Aug 18, 2025 at 9:02 AM Mateo Alvarez wrote:
> Thanks team — quick consolidated plan for Alex's remote full-loop next week...

I can take slot 2 (system design / backend). Happy to split my 45 into 30 whiteboard + 15 Q/A to keep things moving. Proposed panel sequence below (keeps domain diversity in the middle):

- Slot 1 (45m): Screening / product-sense — Laura Bennett (45)
- Slot 2 (45m): System design/backend — Marissa Cole (30/15)
- Slot 3 (45m): Frontend / API design — Soojin Lee (45)
- Slot 4 (30m): Culture & role fit — Mateo Alvarez (30) + 15m buffer for candidate questions

Debrief: I agree with a synchronous 10-min debrief immediately after slot 3 in a dedicated Zoom breakout (all interviewers join). Then we have a 20-min asynchronous score submission window before we finalize notes. I'll take ownership of kicking off the break-out and starting the scorecard doc. I'll attach a quick debrief-template.docx in my next message.

Marissa
Staff Engineer, Panel Lead

From: Alex Tran <alex.tran@gmail.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: TalentFlow Recruiting <recruit@talentflow.io>
Date: 2025-08-18T13:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate relay, debrief cadence, and AV checklist for remote full-loop

Thanks — confirmed on my side. All four slots on Aug 27 work. One note: I'm in PDT but traveling that week and my hotel WiFi can be flaky. I can do the AV check 20 mins prior as suggested; if my video drops, I'm happy to dial in by phone (number below).

Phone: +1 (415) 555-0124
Preferred pronouns: he/him

See you all then — Alex

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Alex Tran <alex.tran@gmail.com>
Date: 2025-08-19T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate relay, debrief cadence, and AV checklist for remote full-loop

Thanks for the plan. A few clarifications so ops are crisp on the day: 

- Live debrief cadence: let's do 10-minute live debrief immediately after slot 3 (so the interviewer who finishes slot 3 remains 10 mins to join). If someone cannot (e.g., schedule conflict), they must submit notes in the 20-min asynchronous window.
- Scorecard: use the ALX-123 eval sheet (link above). Marissa — can you paste the scorecard template into the shared doc and pre-fill the candidate + job info?
- AV contingency: if any interviewer has more than one dropout, move candidate to a single-host call with panelists on audio only; the primary interviewer (Marissa for slot 2) will run audio questions and we will note missing whiteboard in the eval.
- Logistics owner: Mateo, please be ready to open the breakout room and post-call recording (if candidate consents).

Attachments: debrief-template.docx, av-checklist.pdf (attached again)

Laura Bennett
Hiring Manager

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Alex Tran <alex.tran@gmail.com>
Date: 2025-08-19T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Candidate relay, debrief cadence, and AV checklist for remote full-loop

Perfect — thanks everyone. Quick final checklist I will own day-of: 

- 20-min AV checks ping (I'll start Zoom room 20m early and stay until the first slot).
- Breakout + recording permission request (I will enable and ask candidate consent at start).
- Post-interview: I will create the debrief breakout and paste the scorecard link. Please submit your quick notes in the 20-min window.
- Plan B: phone-only continuation (use Alex's mobile + dial-out from Zoom if video fails).

I uploaded the calendar invite (calendar-invite.ics) and re-attached the AV checklist and candidate resume to the event. If anything changes by Friday, flag here and I'll update invites.

— Mateo
Sr. Eng Manager | Redwood Inference
Attachments: calendar-invite.ics, av-checklist.pdf, resume_alex_tran.pdf
